customManagers.description: Bump the pinned zizmor CLI version: the `version: X.Y.Z # pin the CLI` input to zizmor-action. Copied from the isw-kudos/renovate-config :gha preset, which this repo cannot extend: the hosted Renovate app cannot read that private repo.

packageRules.description: Skip minimumReleaseAge for pin updates. Pins carry no release timestamp (renovatebot/renovate#40288), so under timestamp-required they stay pending forever.
GitHub Actions updates use the ci: commit type, matching repo convention
Major updates wait for approval on the Dependency Dashboard
Automerge GitHub Actions digest and patch/minor updates once the required-checks gate passes

Zizmor: the pinned CLI version and the zizmor-action release must move together in ONE gated PR. The action ships a per-version allowlist and fails with 'Unknown version' when the CLI pin is newer than the SHA-pinned action release supports (see isw-kudos/boards#341). The workflow `version:` literal is claimed twice: the zizmor customManager reads it as the github-releases dep zizmorcore/zizmor, and the built-in github-actions manager reads it as the docker dep ghcr.io/zizmorcore/zizmor. ghcr has no release timestamps, so under the default timestamp-required minimumReleaseAgeBehaviour the ghcr dep stays pending and is dropped from the branch; it is listed only so it cannot get its own automerging branch. separateMajorMinor: false keeps a CLI major (e.g. 2.0) in the same PR as the still-0.x action instead of splitting it onto a major-zizmor branch. Mirrors the isw-kudos/renovate-config default preset. This rule MUST stay after the GitHub Actions automerge rule so automerge: false wins.
